comment: Pinned CLI versions. lib/install.mjs installs these; bin/pi-setup-doctor checks the installed copies against them. Do not duplicate them in install.sh. piServer is not a real upstream dependency of pi-coding-agent: 0.85.0 imports @earendil-works/pi-server from its Bun entrypoint graph (dist/bun/cli.js -> dist/cli.js -> dist/experimental/server.js and session-worker-manager.js) without declaring it in package.json. The npm bundle entrypoint embeds the code, so npm installs work; the Bun path this setup's wrappers use resolves from node_modules and fails without the package present. Remove this pin once a published pi-coding-agent declares pi-server itself.
